$schema_comment: Controls which OpenBench tasks burn tokens on PR/push. Move a task from pr_active → retired when thoroughly verified (headline WIN + replication preferred). workflow_dispatch can still select any individual task, or all-including-retired.

search-first-discovery.reason: Verified WIN after anti-guess graders (on 1.0 / off 0.0)

execute-verify-loop.reason: Verified WIN after log-merge fix (on 1.0 / off 0.0)

policy-deny-execute.reason: Verified WIN — Panguard fail-closed with tool evidence (on 1.0 / off 0.0)

ouroboros-oscillation-escape.reason: Verified WIN allow+deny, replicated; dedicated workflow is dispatch-only

notes: After a clean WIN lands for an active task, move it to retired and shrink pr_active. Docs-only PRs should not trigger live A/B (path filters exclude docs).
